episodes.title: Anthropic: A Cult That Wants to Rule the World?
episodes.description: The New York Post and Silicon Valley insiders warn Anthropic isn't just a company, but a cult that has a quasi-religious relationship to its chatbot, Claude. If Democrats get their way, this cult will control much of what you see, hear and know. Plus, America's enemies are using oil as their preferred weapon to help Democrats win the midterms.
